arabic text:
ALL MY PEOPLE I HAVE LEFT, FROM MY CITY I HAVE
FLED, TEARS IN MY EYES HAND ON CHEST
OH YOUR PLACE IS SANCTUARY, IN YOUR LAND IS
SANCTITY, HEAVEN-ON-EARTH I CAN PERCEIVE
FOR YOU THE HEAVENS DO CALL, AT YOUR GATE THE
ANGELS CRAWL
english translation text:
I left all my people and fled my
city, tears in my eyes and my
hand upon my chest. Your land is a
sanctuary and filled with holiness; I can
perceive heaven upon earth. The heavens call for
you, and angels bow at your gate.

arabic text:
JAB BHI UTHEGA KAHIN BATIL KI BAYAT SAWAL
EHLE HAQ KARDENGE ZALIM KE LIYE JEENA MUHAAL
YAAD RAKHEGA ZAMANA JISKO HASHR TAK
KARBALAI FIKR KI QAYIM KARENGE WOH MISAAL
english translation text:
Whenever falsehood demands allegiance anywhere,
the people of truth will make life unbearable for the oppressor.
The age will remember until Judgement Day
the example established by the spirit of Karbala.

arabic text:
TO THE WORLD MY LOVE IS CRAZED, TO MY HEART
YOUR NAME IT PAINS, OH KARBALA YOUR SCENT WE
CRAVE
FOR YOU I WOULD WALK THE LANDS, FOR YOUR
BLESSED GOLDEN SANDS, OH THE TEST OF TIME YOU
STAND
HOW I HAVE WAITED FOR THIS DAY, TO WALK UPON
THIS PATH ONE DAY..
english translation text:
To the world my love appears
like madness; your name aches within
my heart, and we crave Karbala's
fragrance. For you I would cross
every land, for your blessed golden
sands that have withstood the test
of time. How long I waited
for this day—to walk upon this path.

arabic text:
YAAD HAI WHO ROZE ASHOORA SHAHE DEEN KA
KHITAB
WHO SAWALE AAB O ASGHAR KO QATIL KA JAWAB
BHOOL SAKHTI HI NAHIN EHLE HARAM KI BEKASI
english translation text:
We remember the speech of the King of
the faith on Ashura, the plea for
water and the killer's answer to Asghar. The
sacred family can never forget their helplessness.

arabic text: EK EK ZULMO O SITAM KA LENGE GIN GIN KAR\nHISAAB
english translation text: We will account for every oppression\nand cruelty, one by one.

arabic text:
OH THE PASSION I DO SHOW, IN ME LOVE'S SEEDS YOU
HAVE SEWN, FURAT WITHIN ME DOES FLOW
YOU'RE THE MOON WITHIN THE NIGHT, YOU'RE THE
GUIDING SHIP OF LIGHT, FOR ISLAM YOU DID FIGHT
HOW IN PASSION I'M ENFLAMED, YOUR LAND ON MY
HEART IS ENGRAINED..
english translation text:
The passion within me burns; you have sown
love's seeds within me, and the Euphrates flows
through my soul. You are the moon within
the night, the guiding ship of light, and
you fought for Islam. My heart is aflame
with passion, and your land is engraved upon it.

arabic text:
RAN ME JAB POHNCHE SHAHE DEEN SUNKE AKBAR KI
SADA
MUBTALAE JAA(N) KANI WHO SHABEEH E MUSTAFA
YA ALI KEHKAR JO KHENCHI DIL ME PEWASTA SINA
DIL BHI HUMRA E SINA SEENE SE BAHAR AAGAYA
english translation text:
When the King of the faith reached the battlefield
after hearing Akbar's cry, the likeness of Mustafa was struggling
at the edge of death. Calling 'Ya Ali', he
pulled the spear embedded within the heart, and the heart
came out of the chest along with the spear.

arabic text:
HOW PATIENT CAN ONE MAN BE, OH ABBAS CAN'T
BEAR TO SEE, THE CHILDREN WEAK & THIRSTY
ALONE HE WAS OUTNUMBERED, HE LAYS ARMLESS
ON YOUR EARTH, AS IT WEEPS FOR ITS SELF WORTH,
HOW I WISH TO STAND BY YOU, FLAG BEARER OF THE
ONLY TRUTH
english translation text:
How much patience can one man possess? Abbas
cannot bear to see the children weak and
thirsty. Alone and outnumbered, he lies without arms
upon your earth, while the land weeps over
its helplessness. How I wish I had stood
beside you, O standard-bearer of the only truth.

arabic text:
GOONJTI HAI AAJ BHI MAQTAL ME EK BIBI KE BAYN
KIS TARHA AAYEGA MERE LAAL TUJHI BIN MAA KO
CHAYN
KHOON RULAAEGI MUJHE TA HASHR TERI BEKASI
AY MERI AAGHOSH KE PAALE MERE PYAASE HUSSAIN
english translation text:
Even today, the lament of a lady echoes
through the battlefield: How will your mother ever
find peace without you, my beloved? Until Judgement
Day, your helplessness will make me weep blood,
O thirsty Hussain, whom I raised within my embrace.

arabic text:
IN YOUR KINGDOM IN YOUR PLACE, I SEARCH FOR
THE BLESSED FACE, THAT WILL SAVE US ALL ONE
DAY
ONE WHO WILL AVENGE HUSSAIN! THE RADIANT
LIGHT HE RETAINS! DARKNESS TO LIGHT HE WILL
CHANGE..
HOW WE CALL FOR YOU TODAY, RETURN MAHDI WE
PRAY!
english translation text:
Within your kingdom and your
land, I search for the
blessed face who will save us
all one day. The one
who will avenge Hussain, whose radiant
light will turn darkness into
light. We call for you today:
return, O Mahdi, we pray.

arabic text:
SAR NIGU HONE NA DENGE PARCHAME ABBAS KO
EK AZA KHAANA BANDENGE DIL E HASAAS
TA ZAHOOR MEHDI E DORAAN KHUD APNE KHOON
HUM BUJHAAENGE ZAMEENE KARBALA KI PYAAS KO
english translation text:
We will never allow Abbas's standard to bow;
we will build a mourning house within every sensitive heart.
Until the reappearance of the Mahdi of the age, with our own blood
we will quench the thirst of Karbala's earth.

arabic text:
WHAT CAN BE SAID OF THAT DAY, THE FINAL PLACE
HE WAS SLAIN, BY THE ONES WHO WENT ASTRAY
HOW UPON YOU THEY DID PREY, HYPOCRISY THEY
DISPLAYED, BY THE ONES WHO WENT ASTRAY
GOD'S MERCY FROM THEM BE REMOVED, BLESSINGS
BE UPON THE TRUTH
english translation text:
What can be said of that day
and the final place where he was
slain by those who went astray? They
preyed upon him and revealed their hypocrisy.
May God's mercy be withheld from
them, and blessings remain upon the truth.

arabic text:
HAAYE WHO SHAAM E GHAREEBAAN WHO HUJOOM E
BEKASI
LUT RAHE THE JAL RAHE THE KHAYMA E AALE NABI
KARBALA KE DASHT ME THA EK MEHSHAR SA BAPA
HAR TARAF THI YA HUSSAYNA KI SADA GUNJI HUWI
english translation text:
Alas, that night of the bereaved and that
crowd of helplessness; the tents of the Prophet's
family were being looted and burned. A Day
of Judgement had arisen in Karbala's desert; from
every side echoed the cry of 'Ya Hussain'.

arabic text:
YOUR WOUNDS I WISH TO ATTEND, YOUR BROKE
HEART I WISH TO MEND, YOUR TENTS I WISH TO
DEFEND
ONCE MORE MY PLEDGE I RENEW, HOW I WISH TO BE
WITH YOU, STANDING ON THE SIDE OF THE TRUTH
HOW UPON YOU REIGNED THE SPEARS, YET YOU
STOOD WITHOUT A FEAR…
english translation text:
I wish to tend your wounds,
mend your broken heart and defend
your tents. Once more I renew
my pledge: how I wish I
had been with you, standing upon
the side of truth. Spears rained
upon you, yet you stood without fear.

arabic text:
UTH RAHA JAB KHAYAAM E AAL E ATHAR SE
DHUWAN
EK BACHI THI AKELI JAANIBE MAQTAL RAWAAN
NAAGAHAN EK SAR BURIDA LAASH SE AAYI SADA
AY SAKINA AA MERE SEENE PE SOJA MERI JAAN
english translation text:
When smoke rose from the tents of
the pure family, a little girl walked
alone towards the battlefield. Suddenly a voice
came from a headless body: O Sakina, come
and sleep upon my chest, my beloved.

arabic text:
ALI'S ELOQUENCE NOW TALKS, ZAINUL ABIDEEN HE
WALKS, LESSON OF PATIENCE HE TAUGHT
BEATEN DRAGGED SHACKLED IN CHAINS, UPON HIM
HIS ILLNESS PAINS, BUT HIS LORDS PLEASURE HE
GAINS
AS HE DID THE WALK THAT TIME, WE WALK NOW TO
YOUR BLESSED SHRINE
english translation text:
Ali's eloquence now speaks as Zayn
al-Abidin walks, teaching the lesson of
patience. Beaten, dragged and shackled in
chains, afflicted by illness, yet attaining
his Lord's pleasure. As he
walked that journey then, we now
walk towards your blessed shrine.

arabic text:
PARCHAM E ABBAS KE SAAYE ME HUM EHLE AZA
TA QAYAMAT KAM NA HONE DENGE TAWQEER E
WAFA
KYUN NA DEKHEIN MOWT KI AAKNHON ME AANKHEN
DAAL KAR
APNA WIRSA HAI SHAHADAT APNI MANZIL KARBALA
english translation text:
Beneath Abbas's standard, we mourners will
never allow the honour of loyalty
to diminish until Judgement Day. Why
should we not look death directly
in the eyes? Martyrdom is our
inheritance, and Karbala our destination.
